summary: WaveDudeNext is a 2D wave propagation simulator written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly for educational use. It runs locally via a CLI or as a WASM module without requiring an API key. The tool is suited for students or hobbyists learning wave physics, offering a simple interface but limited performance and community support. While it installs quickly, only one of five tests passes and benchmarks show no speed advantage, and documentation details are sparse.

github.description: Interactive 2D wave optics simulator. Turn any image into a refractive scene, add sources, watch waves refract, diffract and interfere. Probes, intensity maps, video export.

negative_signals: Some technical confusion about optical concepts
